posts.text: Do asylum-seekers in the United States need to assimilate to the American culture? No, @zackheeter  Assimilation is cultural, while seeking asylum is an international law concept that implies someone fleeing a country to seek protection from another one. The need for “assimilation“ has been used by some to justify denying asylum and that’s not right.
